AERIAL SIGHTSEEING FLIGHTS OVER NEW YORK
Flight No. 1.-The $10.00 Flight leaves 79th Street and flies up the
Hudson to about Grant's Tomb and down around the Battery circling the
Statue of Liberty. This affords a wonderful view of the city with its architec-
tural wonders, the Palisades and the Ramapo Mountains of New Jersey.
Flight No. 2.-The $20.00 Flight makes a complete circuit of the
Island of Manhattan; flying
down the
Hudson
around
Battery and
Statue of Liberty, up the East River past Hell Gate,
the
Bronx, and then
down the Hudson River.
All of the 10,000 passengers who have flown in
our boats in
safety and comfort comment enthusiastically on the dependa-
bility of the Aeromarine organization.

travel, while having the assurance of being absolutely safe.
